title: Ten Seats — Act I, "Tuesday night"
source: packages/signal-canon/data/story/s01e01.json, items 10–18 (canon, frozen 23 Sep 2026); every word below is the canon's

lines: It's EQ. Something's building up in the mids. I can cut it.
Wait. If I change it now, I lose what it sounds like now.
Are you going to let it sign the report?
That broom has done more acoustics than most consultants.
It's more reliable than the last one who did.
Who's qualified to be under that?

shots.caption: Priya photographs every cable for the drawing she promised (DEBT-009).
Ray says nothing. This is his new stage: waiting.
